description: List the emails an invoice was sent with, newest first with cursor pagination: recipients, time, delivery, reply-to, and whether its link is active, expired, revoked or failed, with when it was first opened. defaultRecipients are the client's email addresses, primary first; replyTo is where replies to a new send would go, or null when the reader has no verified sending address. Pass nextCursor as cursor to read older sends.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
